features.intro: Choose a provider and model for each feature, for example a fast model for triage and a stronger one for summaries. A feature makes no AI calls while it is off.

descriptions.triage: Suggests the category, priority and team for new tickets; agents accept or correct the suggestion.
descriptions.reply: Drafts replies from the knowledge base in the agent's chosen language.
descriptions.translation: Translates messages with one click, so agent and requester can each use their own language.
descriptions.duplicates: Finds tickets that report the same issue.
descriptions.sentiment: Detects frustrated customers so they can be escalated.
descriptions.virtualAgent: Answers questions in the portal and chat from the knowledge base and hands over to a person.
descriptions.articleDrafts: Drafts knowledge articles from resolved tickets for review.

malwareDefinitions.title: Malware definitions
malwareDefinitions.intro: Every uploaded file is checked by the ClamAV malware scanner before anyone can download it. Its definitions must be current to recognise new malware. Zelvo gives ClamAV the definition files you import here, so installations without internet access stay protected; ClamAV checks each file's signature from ClamAV's publisher before it loads it.

malwareDefinitions.loadedUnknown: Not known yet: the scanner has not answered.
malwareDefinitions.scannerUnreachable: The scanner did not answer the last check.
malwareDefinitions.outdated: The definitions are older than {days} days. Import current definition files below, or check that ClamAV can download them.
malwareDefinitions.importIntro: Choose the main, daily and bytecode files (.cvd or .cld, and their .cvd.sign files if you have them), for example from ClamAV's cvdupdate tool or freshclam on a computer with internet access. Each file is listed with its type, version and date before you import it. ClamAV loads imported files within 30 minutes.
malwareDefinitions.inboxEmpty: No definition files are waiting in the inbox.
malwareDefinitions.imported: The files passed every check and were imported. ClamAV loads them within 30 minutes.
malwareDefinitions.warningDays: Warn when the definitions are older than (days)
malwareDefinitions.warningDaysHelp: From 1 to 90 days. Administrators of this installation are told in Zelvo and by email, once for each version.
malwareDefinitions.autoDownloadHelp: For installations with internet access: ClamAV downloads definitions from ClamAV's own servers when Zelvo has no newer imported files. Turn it off to make ClamAV use only the files imported here.

mine.intro: These are the figures your team leads see about you, and the alerts they see. They help balance work; they are not used to rank or score you.

mine.recorded: Once a day: the open tickets assigned to you weighted by priority, new assignments, your changes in Zelvo outside your team's working hours (replies, state changes and work on tasks) and the share of angry or escalated tickets you handle. Nothing about your presence or typing. The figures are kept for 90 days, every view of them is recorded, and they are part of the copy of your data you can ask for under Account → Privacy.

settings.intro: The wellbeing dashboard helps team leads balance work before anyone is overloaded. It is off by default. Under the UAE Personal Data Protection Law, tell staff what is recorded and why before turning it on; Zelvo then notifies every agent in the app and by email.
